subject: one miniature sculptural ceramic bench for a short outdoor pause
colors: Bench ceramic: warm apricot #F4BC83 with restrained same-family shading
idea: A small place to sit for a minute; one warm bench is the unmistakable first-read object.
construction: One compact backless bench, a broad thick seat with a slight upward sweep only at the right end, carried by two substantial short wedge-shaped feet. Overall width-to-height about 1.25:1. The feet and seat are one cast ceramic piece with smooth intentional joins. Keep one wide bright gap between the feet. Almost frontal, with a slight view from above sufficient to show the seat thickness. No park scene, ground plane, plant, person, miniature prop or enclosing badge.
material: Smooth matte glazed ceramic with broad soft upper-left illumination and restrained depth. No surface grain or pores, inflated plastic, chrome, glass, dramatic spotlight or external cast/contact shadow. Internal object shading only; uniform flat cobalt background.
small_size: The seat, the asymmetric raised end and the open gap between two feet must survive 32px.
reference: Product-relevant single-object construction; no product-brand shape or source image conditioning.
difference: A concrete ceramic object with depth, unlike the open mark and exact lettering.
risk: Could look like furniture advertising or a tiny unreadable bench; keep the object large, frontal and compact.
